I have my 1.69 hectares of maize here in Manyara, and I farm it together with some beans between the rows like I always do. Last season the rains were not too bad, so I managed to put a little DAP at planting and some urea when the maize was knee-high — I will do the same this year if the agro-dealer in town has stock when I have the money. I do not have cattle of my own but my neighbor gives me some manure for the part near the homestead, and I will use the same local seed I saved from last harvest because the improved seed is expensive and I am not sure the rains will come well enough to make it worth the risk. My two older children help me in the field and I sometimes pay a few young men for weeding when the grass gets ahead of me.
